description: This file is a shell script used for managing database migrations in a PostgreSQL environment. It reads configuration, applies SQL migration files, manages seed data, and tracks applied migrations and seeds.

methods.name: apply_migration
methods.description: Applies a SQL migration file if it has not been applied before, and records its application.

methods.name: apply_seed
methods.description: Applies seed SQL if not already applied, and records its application.
